inputs.description: RUN_ID to download/export logs for (see terminal output of the run that produced it, or results/reproducibility/COLAB_STATUS.md 'last run id')

tasks.label: Colab: Bootstrap WSL
tasks.detail: Install/verify uv, python3, git inside WSL2 Ubuntu.

tasks.label: Colab: Verify CLI
tasks.detail: Install/update the real google-colab-cli via uv; print its version.

tasks.label: Colab: Authenticate
tasks.detail: Explicit OAuth2 authentication against the Colab backend (interactive).

tasks.label: Colab: Start CPU
tasks.detail: Create/reuse the canonical CPU session drift-tinyml-cpu.

tasks.label: Colab: Start T4
tasks.detail: Create/reuse the optional GPU session with a T4 accelerator (allocation not guaranteed).

tasks.label: Colab: Start G4
tasks.detail: Create/reuse the optional GPU session with a G4 accelerator (allocation not guaranteed).

tasks.label: Colab: Status
tasks.detail: List all sessions and canonical CPU/GPU session status.

tasks.label: Colab: Smoke Test
tasks.detail: One-command ephemeral Colab job (Mode C). NOT scientific evidence.

tasks.label: Colab: Prepare Workspace
tasks.detail: Build dist/colab_workspace.tar.gz from the local repo (excludes .git, venvs, secrets, caches).

tasks.label: Colab: Upload Workspace
tasks.detail: Upload + extract the workspace bundle to /content/drift_tinyml_enose; verify required paths.

tasks.label: Colab: Install Requirements
tasks.detail: Install requirements-colab.txt remotely; verify baseline imports.

tasks.label: Colab: Mount Drive
tasks.detail: Mount Google Drive; create the canonical persistent folder tree.

tasks.label: Colab: Run Notebook 00
args: RUN_ID=$(python3 -m src.colab_control.manifest new-run-id --descriptor MANUAL_NB00); echo RUN_ID=$RUN_ID; scripts/colab/run_notebook.sh notebooks/00_environment_and_reproducibility.ipynb $RUN_ID
tasks.detail: Execute Notebook 00 on real Colab; persist the executed copy under runs/<RUN_ID>/.

tasks.label: Colab: Run Notebook 01
args: RUN_ID=$(python3 -m src.colab_control.manifest new-run-id --descriptor MANUAL_NB01); echo RUN_ID=$RUN_ID; scripts/colab/run_notebook.sh notebooks/01_dataset_audit_and_drift_characterization.ipynb $RUN_ID
tasks.detail: Execute Notebook 01 on real Colab (hard dataset gate) as a standalone run.

tasks.label: Colab: Run Notebook 02
args: RUN_ID=$(python3 -m src.colab_control.manifest new-run-id --descriptor MANUAL_NB02); echo RUN_ID=$RUN_ID; scripts/colab/run_notebook.sh notebooks/02_classical_chronological_baselines.ipynb $RUN_ID
tasks.detail: Execute Notebook 02 on real Colab as a standalone run (only meaningful after 01 passes).

tasks.label: Colab: Run Core Reproduction
tasks.detail: Full 00 -> 01 (dataset gate) -> 02 orchestration on real Colab CPU.

tasks.label: Colab: Run Checkpoint 2
tasks.detail: Checkpoint-2 orchestration: runtime/workspace/dataset verify -> baselines -> expanding window -> IID diagnostic -> artifacts. No deep learning.

tasks.label: Colab: Download Results
tasks.detail: Download small validated artifacts (metrics, manifests, logs, figures, tables, notebooks) for a RUN_ID.

tasks.label: Colab: Export Logs
tasks.detail: Export session logs locally (results/reproducibility/logs/) and best-effort to Drive.

tasks.label: Colab: Open Runtime URL
tasks.detail: Print CPU session status, including its runtime URL if the installed CLI exposes one. Syntax unverified until `colab status --help` is inspected.

tasks.label: Colab: Stop Session
tasks.detail: Stop the canonical CPU session and VERIFY it actually stopped.
